title: Do high interest rates mean the price of homes will drop?
description:
The correlation between interest rates and the price of homes has varied throughout the years, but recent data shows that high interest rates do not guarantee home prices will drop. With the high interest rates lately, there has been a slower rise in appreciation for homes. Unlike, previous years where the growth from year to year was significant. Why is now still a good time to buy a home? If you plan to live in a home for 2-3 years it is better to buy now and refinance later. When you rent you pay 100% interest with no financial return. Buying a home is an investment in your future. Real estate is a wealth-building investment. Samantha Jackson, lender, and Bill Vernon, realtor, have worked in the real estate industry for over 12 years. They have seen the crash of 2008, the historically low interest rates of 2020, and the current economic fluctuations.
